subject: Re: Evidence request - scan cadence, SLA & CVE remediation attestation
messages:
From: Daniel Morris <daniel.morris@acmepay.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request - scan cadence, SLA & CVE remediation attestation

Hi Priyom,

Hope youre well. AcmePay security intake here - were working on the SIG/SOC2 evidence pack for our vendor review next week. We need a short attestation and supporting artifacts covering vulnerability management (scan cadence, SLAs for CVE triage/closure, and remediation evidence). Specifically: 

- A one-page attestation (signed) that outlines Redwoods SLA windows for Critical/P1/P2 CVEs and your exception process.
- The current scan cadence and scanning scope (SCA/container/image/infra) and where weekly/monthly results land.
- A sample evidence bundle (scan export + remediation manifest) demonstrating a closed P1 in the past 90 days.

Can you confirm whether thats something you can provide by EOD Friday (7/3)? If possible, please route the attestation through DocuSign so our audit team can record it. Ive attached the Acme intake checklist for reference.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Morris
Security Engineer, AcmePay
security@acmepay.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Morris <daniel.morris@acmepay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request - scan cadence, SLA & CVE remediation attestation

On Tue, Jun 30, 2026 at 09:12 AM Daniel Morris <daniel.morris@acmepay.com> wrote:
> Hi Priyom,
>
> Hope youre well. AcmePay security intake here - were working on the SIG/SOC2 evidence pack for our vendor review next week.
>
Thanks Daniel 12 happy to help. We can provide the attestation and a sample evidence bundle by EOD Friday. Quick summary below and next steps at the bottom. Ill attach the runnable artifacts and a one-page attestation document for signature.

High-level VM commitments (for inclusion in attestation):
- Scan cadence: nightly authenticated host/image scans for infra + weekly SCA for dependencies + monthly container image full-scan.
- Triage SLA: initial triage within 24 hours of detection.
- Remediation SLAs: Critical/P1: target 72 hours (hotfix/handover); P2: 14 days; P3: 30 days (exceptions documented).
- Evidence cadence: weekly evidence bundle export (scan outputs + remediation manifests) kept for 365 days; audit-ready slice for SOC2 provided on request.

Operational notes: we run vulnerability scanning as part of CI and nightly orchestration jobs; high-severity alerts route to on-call and a security runbook that includes rollback/hotpatch procedures. We will include the runbook excerpt and the patch rollback checklist in the bundle.

Deliverables I will upload to the Drive link below and route the attestation via DocuSign: 
- redwood-vm-runbook-v1.2.pdf (excerpt, includes rollback/hotpatch steps)
- cve-sla-matrix.xlsx (SLA table + exception workflow)
- sample-scan-export-20260422.json (redacted)

Proposed next steps:
1) Ill upload the artifacts to https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cVmEvidence by EOD Thu (7/2).
2) Well send the one-page attestation through DocuSign (https://www.docusign.com/track/ABC123-Map) - please review and sign.
3) If you want a tighter cadence (e.g., daily proof bundle for the pilot), let us know and we can enable a temporary feed to your S3 bucket.

Ccd Laura and Ben to keep the SOC2 and account teams in the loop.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Morris <daniel.morris@acmepay.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 08:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request - scan cadence, SLA & CVE remediation attestation

On Tue, Jun 30, 2026 at 11:03 AM Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> High-level VM commitments (for inclusion in attestation):
> - Scan cadence: nightly authenticated host/image scans for infra + weekly SCA for dependencies + monthly container image full-scan.
> - Triage SLA: initial triage within 24 hours of detection.
> - Remediation SLAs: Critical/P1: target 72 hours (hotfix/handover); P2: 14 days; P3: 30 days (exceptions documented).

LGTM. Two asks before we hand the attestation over: 
1) Include the data retention window for scan exports (we keep exports for 365 days, but call that out explicitly in the attestation).
2) Add a one-line reference to our hotpatch window and rollback playbook (section 4.2 of the runbook). Customers often ask where to find the rollback steps.

Ill coordinate with Priyom on the DocuSign envelope so legal can do a quick sweep.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Security Programs
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

From: Daniel Morris <daniel.morris@acmepay.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 15:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request - scan cadence, SLA & CVE remediation attestation

Thanks all  appreciate the quick turnaround. We reviewed the summary and the Drive artifacts you uploaded (sample bundle looks fine). A couple of quick notes: 

- Attestation: please route via DocuSign when ready and include the explicit retention line Kimberly called out.
- Evidence sample: your sample P1 closure manifest has enough detail for our intake; wed like the remediation ticket ID (redacted) to appear in the manifest export for our audit trail.
- Kickoff: Can we schedule a 30-minute kickoff next Tuesday (7/6) to walk through the runbook and exception procedures? If possible have the security runbook owner attend.

If you can send the DocuSign link and a redacted ticket ID before EOD Monday (7/5), well mark this intake complete and proceed to SIG review.

Best,
Daniel
Security Engineer, AcmePay
